name: full-width-toggle
description: Page-container width toggle (contained / wide / full). Per-device localStorage with cross-tab sync. useFullWidth hook + FullWidthToggle button + WidthContainer wrapper. React/Next default; Svelte/SvelteKit available through slice.json framework metadata.
notes: Pure client-side slice — no Convex or env. React/Next default uses shadcn `button` and lucide-react; explicit Svelte/SvelteKit distribution uses native buttons/SVG icons and requires only `svelte@^5`. localStorage key: `layout:widthMode`.
